Image title and alt txt should be filled in manually as much as possible. Don't ignore its importance.
"Only supplement" means applying the optimization rules when there is no ALT and Title, and "Full coverage" means applying all the optimization rules.
Robots.txt is used to tell search engines whether page links are allowed to be crawled or indexed.
You can use the Robots online tool to verify whether the robots.txt rules are compliant and detect whether the URL is blocked by spiders.
Make sure no other robots.txt generators are enabled and delete the robots.txt file in the website directory, otherwise the settings will not take effect.
Reference tutorials: How to write and optimize Robots.txt for WordPress and In-depth understanding of Robots.txt.
The webmaster tools of major search engines can be verified in a variety of ways, including DNS resolution, uploading HTML files, and adding meta descriptions.
This module can be disabled if webmaster platform authentication is not required on weekdays.
Webmaster platform quick entry: Baidu, Google GSC, Bing, Sogou, 360 search, Yandex, Shenma search, Toutiao search.
Baidu, 360 search and Toutiao search do not support sitemap notifications, but sitemaps can be submitted manually.
XML sitemap for different search engines: Baidu Search Resource Platform, Bing Webmaster Tool, Google Search Console, 360 Webmaster Platform and Toutiao Search Webmaster Platform
In order to improve the indexing effect, recommended to install the search push plug-in to submit URLs to search engines in multiple ways at the same time.
Recommended to include independent tag & author pages in the Sitemap. Webmasters need to make choices based on their own circumstances.
Internal link optimization is an important part of SEO and is also a form of link bait.
External links should have the Nofollow attribute added to prevent the page weight from being distributed to other sites.
Webmasters can refer to SEO optimization techniques link building and put it into practice.
404 code does not mean that the link must exist on the website. It may be caused by security scanning, crawler and other programs.
To help you better judge 404 errors, recommended to install the spider analyser plugin.
For real 404 status links, you can install BSL plugin to generate 404 link set URL and submit it to notify the search engine.
Some abnormal links may be caused by inaccessibility in some areas. Recommended to add such domains to the exclusion domain list.
Corresponding to the redirect link, recommended to change the URL to the final URL.
Some servers will deny system detection access and return 403 or 503 status. In this case, you don't need to pay attention.
For security reasons, cross-domain redirects are not supported.
WordPress redirect best practices to maximize SEO and improve page speed.
Regarding 301 permanent redirection or 302 temporary redirection, you can read 301 redirection and SEO and 301 vs 302.

If most link rules are changed, recommended to add new rules for matching redirection. For example, if the category news is changed to blog, you can add a 301 redirect rule: /news/(*) redirects to /blog/$1.
